protocol.arm_off: prompt bez kontekstu z grafu, tylko terminal respond
protocol.arm_on: ten sam prompt + wstrzykniety kontekst z ask.py top-k (k=5); route.py odpalane przez harness na tagach zadania (rc logowane)
protocol.criterion_solved: odpowiedz cytuje >=1 oracle chunk ID ORAZ wszystkie cytowania resolvuja w zywym grafie
protocol.criterion_resolve: resolve rate liczone tylko na zadaniach z >=3 cytowaniami (flaga phase2_hypothesis)
protocol.criterion_concentration: A z fallbackiem: (cytowania top-3)/(wszystkie cytowania); zadania z 0 cytowan wykluczone, liczba wykluczonych raportowana osobno
protocol.dead_route: dead-route rate = dead queries / total harness queries w ramieniu ON; OFF nie wykonuje zapytan (N/A); guardrail musi trzymac 0
protocol.rescue: rescue_enabled=true w obu ramionach (nie jest leczeniem; leczenie = obecnosc kontekstu)

tasks.question: An agent reflection pipeline cites the same 3 chunks in every digest (100% concentration on 4/4 rows). What concrete mechanism mitigates this citation concentration, and how does it work?

An agent queries the knowledge graph with --tag flags and gets zero chunks back with no error. What is this failure mode called, and what should the router do instead of returning an empty list silently?
After new sources are ingested, all prior reflection digests carry a stale corpus fingerprint. What is the correct remediation when cited chunk IDs no longer resolve?
Design a cheap pre-retrieval gate that scores FTS5 hits as useful/redundant/confusing BEFORE running 1-hop neighbor expansion. What is this pattern called and what failure does it prevent?
The agent memory file grows without bound (write-only memory, no eviction). Which surveyed system provides the only working eviction model, and what is its core mechanism?
What is the cheapest surveyed code-graph edge schema, which 4 edge kinds does it use, and what SWE-bench gain was reported?
Single-step PPR over a knowledge graph matches iterative IRCoT recall at what reported gain and cost ratio, and what follows for route.py query handling?
How does ICM invert the standard GraphRAG cost profile - specifically, where is LLM compute spent and where is it absent?
Route.py matches tag intersections directly against the graph. What pre-match step does the Phase 1 synthesis recommend, and which finding motivates it?
